leaseTest.method: Exact claim-function body against temporary copies of production table definitions, transaction rolled back. Expired submission fails for review, its public run stops running, next queued task is claimed, no second worker claims the live task.

historyNotice: Remote versions are the actual MCP-recorded deployment versions. Original preparation SQL filenames are preserved and mapped; do not blindly re-run historical migrations against production.

projectCreationTest.method: Actual Japanese create RPC and repeated idempotency request in a rolled-back transaction; no persistent user test projects or provider requests.
